generation.image_prompt: [CLEAN_V3_STRICT_NO_BORDERS] 1900s mystical lithography, bold ink outlines. ANTHROPOMORPHIC: A Taiwan leopard cat in traveler's clothing standing on a cliff overlook. VISUAL FOCUS: Exactly 2 wooden wands must be present in total. One wooden wand is held in his right hand like a staff, and another wooden wand is planted firmly in the ground beside him. He holds a small glowing globe (the world) in his left hand. He looks out over a vast sea. High-fidelity biological markers: narrow face, white stripes nose-to-forehead, white ear spots. 2:3 vertical. Full bleed. No borders.
generation.narrative: A leopard cat stands at a vantage point, holding its territory in its hand while evaluating the distant fragments of forest. It represents the crucial planning stage before moving into new habitat.

meanings.upright: Planning, decision-making, looking ahead, and evaluates potential path between habitat fragments.
meanings.reversed: Indecision, fear of the unknown, or poor evaluation of landscape safety.

ecology.mapping_note: Two of Wands becomes the decision to move between distant forest patches—a calculated risk based on environmental reading.
ecology.zh: 棲地樣貌：高處俯瞰的制高點。生存威脅：領地擴張時面臨的未知風險。牌義關聯：權杖二代表著「長遠規劃」——站在至高點規劃族群未來的擴散路徑。
ecology.en: Habitat: high mountain ridge. Risk: connectivity evaluation. Note: Two of Wands becomes the decision to move between distant forest patches—a calculated risk based on environmental reading.

website.excerpt: Evaluating the landscape from a high ridge, the leopard cat plans its next move between forest fragments.
website.seo_description: Two of Wands reimagined as leopard cat landscape evaluation and planning.

meaning.zh: 規劃、決策、目光遠大，並評估不同棲地碎片之間的潛在路徑。
meaning.en: Planning, decision-making, looking ahead, and evaluates potential path between habitat fragments.
